errors.text_span: and tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.01
errors.evidence: The tick labels on the x-axis are not consistently spaced at 0.01 intervals. For example, the interval between the first two ticks (0.86 and 0.88) is 0.02, and the value 0.87 is missing.
The Final Accuracy line starts at an initial confidence of 0.86 with an accuracy value of approximately 0.92, not 0.96.
The ∆ Accuracy line starts at an initial confidence of 0.86 with an accuracy value of approximately 0.28, not 0.35.
The ∆ Accuracy line ends at an initial confidence of 1.00 with an accuracy value of approximately 0.21, not 0.15.
The Initial Accuracy line is described as solid, but in the plot it has a dash-dotted line style.
The description fails to mention the error bars present on all data points for all three lines, which are a significant feature indicating variability or uncertainty in the measurements.
